key_idea: The school in the photo must look just like the school, with Sam in front.
steps: The school has a pink roof on the left, a clock tower in the middle and a flag on the right tower.
Sam is in his own photo, so we must see his face too.
Only B has the right school and Sam.

choice_feedback.A: The school is flipped: the flag is on the left.
choice_feedback.C: The middle tower has a window, not a clock.
choice_feedback.D: Sam is not in this photo.
choice_feedback.E: There is no clock and no flag.
